goal.what: A person who meets turn decides from the README whether to use it, starts by its steps alone, and knows where to read next.

decisions.what: turn makes a piece of work you ask for until it is what it should be.
Gain: the work as it should be, your effort only on what only you decide.
Idea: format and checklist drawn from how good works are made and approved by you; a second AI that never sees the design checks the work.
Non-goals: the purpose, whether the work achieves it, publishing, a quick draft.
grounds: limits a reader would ask about
